lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: What a dismal evening.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
I'm sure you're already aware of this, 
but always drink in a safe place.
The alcohol you're drinking is incredibly strong.
It'll impair your judgment.
Please bear that in mind.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Such swiftness in thy reply!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Most unexpected indeed!
That really was fast. Is someone else replying to your message for you?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text: I saw your message, so I replied. What's so surprising about that?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Because you hardly ever

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: reply to messages so soon.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: But let's leave that aside for now. Is Scarlet drunk?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: What, perchance, led thine to such a supposition?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Dost thou have a penchant for spying on me?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Also, might thou wish to partake in a drink with me?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Doesn't Scarlet usually drink around this time anyway?
Change "around this time" to "all the time", and you'll be in the right ballpark.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Well,

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: thy gazes all pierce through me so easily.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: This must surely act as a testament to our acquaintanceship.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Tis enough to make one shimmer with joy!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: One more bottle of sake, then!
If you want to keep drinking, you don't have to make excuses.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Hehe, my good fellow, more and more ye

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: doth taketh a liking to the telling of truths.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Would thou perchance be inclined to allow me to bequeath the art of Swordsmanship upon ye?
No, thanks.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Aye, tis a crying shame!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: How about learning some prayers, then?

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: A candle faintly glimmers in a dark church.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Two people pray alone... on their knees... hehehe

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: HAHAHA.
I prefer praying by myself.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
That's right. Don't force yourself to learn anything.
What you should learn is how to better make use of Nikkes to fight against the Raptures and how to survive.
If I had to suggest one more thing you could learn... it would be how to operate anti-ship rifles.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: That's no mean feat!

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: When you say "learning,"

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I assume you mean becoming as proficient as yourself?

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
?
But of course.
If I were to provide instruction, I would teach everything I know.
Sorry, a little intense for me.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
Very well.
If you are not willing to learn, I will not force you to do so.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Looks like all of us got turned down.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Fair treatment for all! Hahaha.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Come, join me.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Drink with me.

lines.speaker: snowwhite
lines.text:
No.
I gotta go.
I'll talk to you later.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: I must go pray.

lines.speaker: rapunzel
lines.text: Blessings be upon you. Until we meet again.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: My good fellow, won't the drink with me?
I can't play favorites, so I must refuse.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Alas!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: A truly dismal evening if there ever was one!
